text:
Мотоциклист, мчащийся на большой скорости, неожиданно замечает летящего прямо на него… воробья! Он давит на тормоз, всячески пытается увернуться, но все же задевает воробья шлемом. Воробей отлетает в сторону и падает. Мотоциклисту стало жаль бедную пташку. Кое-как отыскав лежащего на земле воробья, он его взял с собой, привез к себе домой, поместил в клетку, поставил ему блюдечко с водой, насыпал хлебных крошек, после чего пошел спать. Наутро воробей приходит в себя, оглядывается по сторонам и говорит сам себе:
— Где это я?.. Так-так… решетка… плошка с водой… хлеб… Какой ужас! Я убил мотоциклиста!
gist: A biker who hit a sparrow puts it in a cage with bread and water, and the sparrow wakes up concluding it is in prison for killing the biker.

characters.looks: biker, leather jacket, helmet, kind face
small brown sparrow, bandaged head, dazed eyes

text:
Идет слет феминистских организаций. На трибуне очередная баба-оратор яростно вещает:
— ... что бы делали эти мужики сейчас без женщин!? Ну вот что бы они без нас делали!? А!? Я вас спрашиваю...!? Мужской голос из зала:
— Что, что!? Жрали бы себе кокосы в раю....!!!!
gist: A feminist speaker asks what men would do without women, and a man in the audience answers they would be eating coconuts in paradise, blaming Eve for the expulsion.

characters.looks: fierce woman at podium, short hair, raised fist
ordinary man in the audience, cupped hands

text:
Jack wakes up with a horrible hangover and a throbbing black eye.
The first thing he sees is a single rose on the side table and a note from his wife: “Dear, breakfast is made. I’ve gone shopping to make you your favorite dinner tonight. I love you!”
He stumbles to the kitchen and, sure enough, there’s breakfast. “Joe,” he says to his son, “what happened last night?”
“You came home soused and got that black eye tripping over a chair.”
“So, why the rose, breakfast, and sweet note from your mother?”
“Oh, that. Mom dragged you to the bedroom, and when she tried to take off your clothes, you screamed, ‘Leave me alone, I’m married!’”
gist: A hungover husband finds a loving note and breakfast from his wife, and his son explains that drunk, he fought off her undressing him shouting he was married.

characters.looks: hungover man, black eye, messy hair, rumpled shirt
teenage son eating cereal, amused smirk
smiling woman, shopping bags

text:
A 911 operator is sitting at her desk when she gets a call.
"911 What's your emergency?" She answers.
"My friend and I were walking through the woods when he just collapsed. I think he died." A man responds. He is very nervous
"Ok, calm down. First, make sure he's dead." The operator replies.
There's a silence on the phone. Then, there's a gunshot.
The man then says, "OK, now what?"
gist: Emergency operator tells a caller to make sure his collapsed friend is dead, and he takes it literally by shooting him.

characters.looks: woman with headset at desk, calm professional
nervous man in plaid jacket, phone, rifle
man lying motionless on forest floor

text:
A nice, calm and respectable lady went into the pharmacy, right up to the pharmacist, looked straight into his eyes, and said, "I would like to buy some cyanide."
The pharmacist asked, "Why in the world do you need cyanide?"
The lady replied, "I need it to poison my husband."
The pharmacists eyes got big and he exclaimed, "Lord have mercy! I can't give you cyanide to kill your husband! That's against the law! I'll lose my license! They'll throw both of us in jail! All kinds of bad things will happen. Absolutely not! You CANNOT have any cyanide!"
The lady reached into her purse and pulled out a picture of her husband in bed with the pharmacist's wife.
The pharmacist looked at the picture and replied, "Well now. That's different. You didn't tell me you had a prescription."
gist: A pharmacist refuses to sell a woman poison to kill her husband until she shows a photo of her husband in bed with the pharmacist's wife, which he accepts as a prescription.

characters.looks: calm respectable middle-aged lady, neat coat, handbag
middle-aged man, white coat, glasses, wide eyes
middle-aged man in bed, sheepish
woman in bed, surprised face
